intermediateRunBoundaries: Initial pan/drag telemetry reset discarded pointerdown; zero matched latency is an instrumentation failure and is excluded.
Initial both playback requests follow production singlePlayback; only the final video continues. No concurrent audio plus video performance claim.
Initial fixtures have approximate dimensions and short audio; final fixtures use exact image dimensions and long complete-file audio.
qualityRules: Native synthetic video resolution and every available decoded presentation callback remain intact.
Each SceneContentFrame owns a synchronous private copy and validates origin cleanliness every frame.
Audio waveforms are drawn every native display frame with current native media time; static panel work follows actual layout and style invalidation.
Audio and video preserve the product singlePlayback policy.

GPU single-canvas command replay matches the same painter GPU reference; original CPU painter logic remains byte-identical while GPU versus CPU antialiasing and image sampling differences are documented separately.
actualMediaLimits: Actual audio/video codec, duration and decoded dimensions were not inspected. Synthetic AAC 256s and MP3 320s retain full-file decode and waveform analysis; synthetic video is 1920x1080 at 30fps, 12s. Actual PNG dimensions/object bounds and approximate transfer byte counts are matched.

audioSeeking.cause: Native seeking changed currentTime before timeupdate/seeked; the displayed cursor and scene metadata still represented the previous time.
audioSeeking.change: Paint the decoded waveform cursor and clock on the native seeking event, publishing playback-sampled metadata in the same private frame. Video decoded-frame timing remains RVFC based.

markOwnership.cause: Producer notifications arrived before scene commit; React cleanup cancelled the hover update and the last hit test used the previous presented layout.
markOwnership.change: Synchronous onPresented notification follows successful pixel and layout commit; stationary hover re-tests that exact presented frame.
markOwnership.result: original Mark and deletion/overlap/camera/resize stationary cases PASS

readerFocus.cause: Pending annotation focus RAF stole focus from the range control before its first ArrowRight.
readerFocus.change: Initialize annotation text focus only when focus is outside the active editor.
readerFocus.result: original managed-media and pending reader close/replace native typing PASS

testSetupLifecycle.cause: Chrome CVDisplayLink setup failed before fixture teardown was registered, leaving the isolated server alive.
testSetupLifecycle.change: Register cleanup immediately after service/session creation; optional-page screenshot has a five-second limit; service and temporary project cleanup use finally. Performance setup has bounded Chrome launch and outer cleanup.

finalScope: Current media/UI/WS/parallel HTML startup/urgent sampling/wheel/F1 CSS animation clock. Programmatic root smooth-scroll same-N capture remains a documented F2 limitation and is outside these synthetic non-scroll performance phases.
finalMeasurementRules: Each build uses one complete 21-input-phase run. Each media already contains two pan/drag/zoom repetitions. A separate cold-only process repeats fresh navigation, same-instance warm reload and session waveform cache cleared reload.

Input latency ends at successful main-thread Canvas commit. GPU/compositor display delay remains outside the measured endpoint. Raw input pairs recheck camera/objectXY, all three current native surface references, terminal input, and superseded coverage.

All four raw numerical JSON documents retain their original structure in gzip archives. Owned private raw files and Chrome traces are retained. Credential-field/value scan found no Authorization/Bearer/token/cookie/nonce; no user asset bodies or user project were included.

Candidate uses the accepted private native F1 clock build; original uses the installed baseline native executable. F2 programmatic root smooth-scroll capture remains explicitly outside these non-scroll synthetic phases.

Original CPU and candidate GPU paint backends retain their ordinary antialiasing/filter differences; same-GPU exact rendering and old-CPU-helper equivalence were separately independently verified. No DPR, source-resolution or playback-rate reduction was applied.

finalFindings.inputPairVerification: Self recomputation passed all raw pairs: camera XYZ, moved object XY, three presented surface references, covered inputs, latency quantiles and terminal positions. Independent numeric review remains pending.
finalFindings.initialization: Image publication/visibility improved in both cold and warm repetitions. Full mixed readiness retains CEF startup variation. The same middle HTML object NativeHtmlRuntime.open took 3031/3270ms on both cache-cleared reloads and 2983ms on the second warm reload while its peers opened in 1.1–1.5s. Constructor/publication and waveform readiness finished earlier; slow-instance first sample was 59–68ms. Its open wait phases remain to be attributed by the HTML executor.
finalFindings.sourceWork: Native video direct publication removed the producer canvas draw and copy. Per-frame private origin verification remains. GPU readback work increased on video in the final run (254.6→594.4ms per six-second sample), while drawImage work fell 2800.1→142.9ms and main-task work 4766.7→1835.2ms. Audio removes repeated panel DOM compilation and redundant paint events; it keeps every animation/display frame.
finalFindings.mixedFrameRate: Native video decoded 185/184 frames in 6.180/6.175s, approximately 29.94/29.80fps. Audio currentTime advanced and AnalyserNode RMS stayed nonzero in both separate layouts. HTML native clock cadence was verified by the HTML executor separately.
finalFindings.memory: The final owned Chrome+CEF RSS sample peaks were 3789.8/3579.5MiB for baseline/candidate; these remain high and a single complete run does not establish a general memory reduction.
finalFindings.scopeLimits: The actual user media codec, duration and decode dimensions were not read. Fixture MPEG audio durations are 256/320s. Measurement ends at main-thread Canvas commit. F2 programmatic root smooth-scroll semantic/pixel pairing remains a documented limitation outside these non-scroll phases.

postMeasurementFocusRegression.scope: Only HTML client focus ownership and the test helper completion identity changed after the archived performance measurement. Audio/video typed paint commands, source resolution, playback scheduling, native F1 sampler and BoardScene commit code were retained. The performance fixture does not focus or edit source HTML controls.
